messages:
maya: Morning all — quick async standup for ingress/routing/auth/rate limits

maya: Yesterday: merged small fix for header normalization that was causing 401s for some clients. Verified in staging + ran smoke by hitting /health and a couple of routes.

maya: Blockers: still seeing intermittent 429 spikes on the /v1/generate endpoint when burst traffic hits our dedicated pool. Can't repro locally; looks like a routing fanout issue.

maya: Today: triage with infra, add more logs around per-route batching and KV cache hits. Will open a short PR to increase client-side retry jitter.


tj: Seen those 429s too. Instrumented a canary with verbose metrics yesterday — request queue depth on pool-B jumps for ~300ms when a big batch lands. Not sure if autoscaler delays or kernel queuing.


tj: Quick note — can we avoid changing retry behavior for all clients? prefer a targeted fix for the generator route only.


sam_k: re: logs — I can add a temporary trace-id passthrough to the gateway so we can correlate with runtime traces. PR by EOD.


olivia: FYI I noticed a related auth edge-case: JWT exp claim parsing drops sub if header had trailing space. small parser tweak fixes it. Rolling to staging in 10m. :shipit:


lee: For rate limits, I ran a sim against the policy engine with burst=200 and sustained=50 and saw policy eviction when upstream responses > 1s. Might be our token bucket window too small.


maya: thanks — can you paste the sim command you used?


lee: sure —

```bash
./rate-sim --policy ingress.json --concurrency 250 --rps 60 --duration 60s --backend-delay 1200ms
```

lee: results: 6% of requests hit enforced-limit, 12% queued > 800ms, median backend latency 1.18s


maya: good data. Maybe we increase burst window to 300 for generator route and add a soft limit that returns Retry-After instead of hard 429 for first few hits?


tj: I can prototype soft-limit behavior in the policy engine today — would like a short rollback plan if it regresses.


sam_k: also propose we enable prefix KV cache for generator route; should reduce backend pressure. I'll coordinate with model infra.


olivia: On the auth side, staging patch rolled. If anyone wants to run quick auth regression tests:

`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://staging.api.redwood/health`

olivia: I added a tiny unit test for trailing-space header case.


deploy-bot: deploy started: maya/header-fix -> staging (build #7821). ETA ~3m.


maya: thanks everyone. Action items:
- lee: tune rate policy and share sim results (+ config diff).
- tj: prototype soft-limit in policy engine and add rollback steps.
- sam_k: trace-id passthrough PR + discuss KV cache enablement.
- olivia: watch auth staging patch and cloud logs for regressions.

maya: I'll join a 30m sync if needed after logs come in. Ping me @maya if you need pairing. :slightly_smiling_face:
